items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-15
items.q: And then I had this fellow, Blind Freddy. ... he's the average guy to play with the whole horn.

ctx.x: I liked it, him for clarinet. Mm-hmm. And then I had another fellow, I liked it pretty good, played with Rene, called him Zib. Oh, yeah. Yeah, he was a nice clarinet player. Mm-hmm. And then I had this fellow, Blind Freddy. Mm-hmm. Wonderful. He could play about as much clarinet with one piece of it, he's the average guy to play with the whole horn. Mm-hmm. And he was a wonderful harmonica player, too. I think he still plays, I don't know.
